name: Project Management Plan
notes: Project Life Cycle, Development Approaches, Subsidiary Management Plans, Variance Thresholds and Baselines are section headings with no box of their own; each is followed by the tables or boxes listed after it. Project Life Cycle has two separate tables, both keyed by Phase (5 blank rows each); keep them as two tables in printed order. Deliverable/Development Approach prints 6 blank rows. In the Subsidiary Management Plans table the row labels Scope through Other Plans are printed in the Name column, with Comment blank. Variance Thresholds is a 3 by 2 grid of large boxes with the label inside the top of each box: threshold on the left, baseline management on the right. Attach all project baselines. is printed instruction text under the Baselines heading, not a field. The prose table (Table 2.1) lists Key reviews for the phase; the blank form column is Reviews.
